content:
**Scorchbeast Steak** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

The cooked flesh of a Scorchbeast.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Scorchbeast Meat (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Scorchbeast Meat | | Scorchbeast Steak (1) | 

Scorchbeast Steak can be cooked at a Cooking Station. The recipe is automatically learned after picking up Scorchbeast Meat for the first time.
